name: agenturm-tui-skills
description: Nine production skills for designing, building, testing, and operating a truthful terminal cockpit for live agent work.

skills.name: terminal-cockpit-design
skills.description: Design a keyboard-first terminal cockpit: IA, responsive layout, evidence-based status, attention, and acceptance criteria.

skills.name: textual-tui-engineering
skills.description: Implement the cockpit in Textual: DataTable projection, lazy views, stale-scope rejection, reflow, and shutdown.

skills.name: tui-regression-testing
skills.description: Test TUIs without trusting screenshots: headless Pilot tests, core-flow regressions, race matrices, real PTY.

skills.name: agent-session-status
skills.description: Classify agent state from evidence: working, quiet, waiting, stalled, finished, or unknown.

skills.name: local-agent-ingestion
skills.description: Read local agent logs/databases with byte budgets, fair resumption, schema drift, and content-free diagnostics.

skills.name: sqlite-telemetry-store
skills.description: Store live agent telemetry in SQLite: indexes, bounded derived data, writer locks, retention, DuckDB decision.

skills.name: monitoring-performance-budgets
skills.description: Benchmark and budget a local monitor: whole-app workloads, deterministic limits, honest resource claims.

skills.name: local-first-monitoring-privacy
skills.description: Design capture, diagnostics, preferences, exports, and retention for a monitor that sees sensitive work.

skills.name: terminal-demo-media
skills.description: Produce honest, legible terminal demo media from real captures: README sizing, synthetic data, visual QA.
